verdict: Palantir's revenue jumped 39% to $884M as U.S. sales soared 55%, and it kept $214M of that as profit for shareholders — then raised its full-year outlook, guiding U.S. commercial revenue to grow 68%.

kpis.label: U.S. commercial revenue
kpis.note: +71% YoY — passed a $1B annual run rate

segments.note: Software for governments, above all the U.S. military and intelligence agencies — up 45% YoY, with U.S. government revenue up 45% to $373M.

segments.note: Software for companies — up 33% YoY, with U.S. commercial revenue up 71% to $255M as the AIP 'bootcamp' push kept winning customers.

footerNote: Net income here is Palantir's total net income of $218M; $214M of it is attributable to common stockholders (the rest belongs to noncontrolling interests). Segment figures are from Palantir's Q1 2025 10-Q. Figures are rounded to whole $M; the tax line is shown as $5M ($5.6M as reported) so the chart ties exactly to reported totals.

takeaways.title: U.S. business customers surged
takeaways.text: U.S. commercial revenue grew 71% YoY to $255M, passing a $1B annual run rate, and Palantir booked its best-ever quarter of U.S. commercial contract value — $810M, up 183%.

takeaways.title: America is the engine
takeaways.text: U.S. revenue rose 55% to $628M — 71% of everything Palantir sells — as government revenue grew 45% and commercial demand for its AI platform (AIP) accelerated.

takeaways.title: Profit, not just growth
takeaways.text: Adjusted free cash flow was $370M — 42 cents of every revenue dollar — and GAAP net income was $214M for shareholders, a 24% margin, with $5.4B of cash and Treasury securities on hand.
